troubleshooting.solution: Match Size X/Y to your viewport aspect ratio. For 16:9 use 16 and 9.
Enable Round Corners toggle and increase Corner Radius above 0.
Check Anchor U/V — Left/Right maps to X, Bottom/Top maps to Y.
Ensure Camera OP reference is valid and Camera Aspect matches your render resolution.

description: Creates a 4-point rectangle with optional rounded corners. Outputs as line strip, triangles, quad, lines, point primitives, or no primitives. Supports Fill Camera View mode for camera-aligned backgrounds and input bounding box modification.
